CREATE TABLE `dimension_name` (
	`code` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
	`dimension` text NOT NULL,
	`id` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `metadata` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY,
	`version` integer NOT NULL,
	`generation` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`history_complete_from` integer NOT NULL,
	`expired_revision` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `project_fact` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`name` text,
	`worktree` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `prompt` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`session` text NOT NULL,
	`position` integer NOT NULL,
	`start` integer NOT NULL,
	`provider` integer,
	`model` integer,
	`variant` integer,
	`agent` integer,
	`project` integer NOT NULL,
	`session_code` integer NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `session_fact` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`parent` text,
	`session` text NOT NULL,
	`project` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`fork` text,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `session_sync` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`counter` integer,
	`message_count` integer NOT NULL,
	`highest_position` integer
);
CREATE TABLE `step` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`session` text NOT NULL,
	`position` integer NOT NULL,
	`start` integer NOT NULL,
	`stream_end` integer,
	`completed` integer,
	`error` integer,
	`failed` integer NOT NULL,
	`interrupted` integer NOT NULL,
	`input` integer,
	`cache_read` integer,
	`cache_write` integer,
	`output` integer,
	`reasoning` integer,
	`provider` integer,
	`model` integer,
	`variant` integer NOT NULL,
	`agent` integer,
	`project` integer NOT NULL,
	`session_code` integer NOT NULL,
	`subagent` integer,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `tombstone` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`deleted_at` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `tool_call` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`step_id` text NOT NULL,
	`session` text NOT NULL,
	`tool` integer NOT NULL,
	`outcome` integer,
	`run_start` integer,
	`completed` integer,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL
);
